title: Grand Egyptian Museum Opens Fully After Two Decades of Construction
detail: The Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM) opened fully to the public on April 26, 2026, following 22 years of construction, pandemic delays, and phased soft openings. The $1 billion museum adjacent to the Giza pyramids is the world's largest museum dedicated to a single civilization, housing over 100,000 artifacts. The opening is anchored by the complete 5,398-piece Tutankhamun collection — displayed in its entirety in public for the first time — and is projected to accelerate Egypt's 2026 tourism surge toward a target of 21 million annual visitors.
